title: Mutate a verifier terminal or issue success twice
preconditions: a verifier flow entered Verified or one of five failure terminals and emitted its direct typed result
steps: attempt each of the twenty-four semantic actions from that terminal
attempt to obtain a second VerifiedAttestation or unsuccessful AppraisalResult
invariants: all six terminals reject all twenty-four semantic actions
one flow terminal emits at most one result and cannot be reclassified
successful conversion consumes the one non-cloneable VerifiedAttestation
residual_risk: future protected-result issuance validation and replay behavior remain separate protocol work
